Must try for cocktail lovers
Aug 2017 • Friends
Monde is located at the end of an alley in district 1. A hidden gem that you will be amazed trying the product and service there. The cocktails-making level can be considered as one of the best place in Ho Chi Minh city with consistent quality and decent price. It is suitable for couples dating, business meeting and even friend gathering. P/S: they are famous with their classic cocktail style and whisky selection.

A gift from Mt Fuji
Aug 2017 • Solo
Did my research on Japanese Bars in Saigon and gave Monde Bar a try. Actually came for their cocktails and whisky selection. It's Thursday evening and didn't have dinner. One of the times I rather go solo. Got myself an Old Fashioned and had a look on their Bar menu, but bar keeper showed me additionally their full food menu. BOOM!!! 4 course fusion french dinner experience setto A! Had pleasant conversation with the attentive staff through the evening. What a place to calm down for a moment....
Return visit ASAP!

Exceptional drinks and food - a hidden gem
May 2017 • Friends
I met some friends at Monde on May 6th, not knowing what the bar was. When I got there I immediately knew I was going to love it. The bar area only allows patrons to sit - not standing and chatting. This is very common at high end Japanese bars. 

As I was hungry, I decided to order a few small dishes to eat at the bar - foie gras, seared wagyu beef, and one more. All were exceptional. 

I will be going back to Monde on a regular basis now, and I highly recommend you give it a try.

Highly Recommended
Sep 2016 • Friends
We were recommended this eatery and now we can do the same for you.
It is decorated in French theme it has a Whisky bar at ground level and a dining area at first floor level.
The food was simply outstanding - the best we have experienced in our 16 days in Vietnam.
The Maitre D' (Oguri) and waitress were attentive without being intrusive.
We ordered 4 different main courses: Chicken,fish(2) duck.
When the meals arrived they were displayed like a work of art and as for the taste- sublime.
We were all so impressed we asked to meet the chef to congratulate him in person. 
Mr. Tien duly stepped out of his busy kitchen to hear our praise.
A young Vietnamese man with extraordinary talent.

Very happy to recommend you dine at this Restuarant.

Nice place, nice view, excellent service together with a wide selection of wine!
Dec 2015 • Business
Located at the heart of city center. After I guided my foreigner friends to Saigon Central Post Office & Notre Dame Cathedral, they would like a place to drink, eat, relax, but it shouldn't be far. Then we walked to Monde Bar. Feeling like we had the best full & great day ever. Monde Bar is truly impressive to me & my friends, who came at the first time. Nice place, nice view, excellent service together with a wide selection of wine from around the world ! Worth to pay, awesome place to enjoy. I will certainly come back next time, and also introduce my friends too!!!
